povzetek: Suflé iz 70-odstotne čokolade v dveh ramekinih; 15 min na 190 °C, postreže se takoj.
opis: Za {kolicina} — dva ramekina po 180 ml. Stopljeni čokoladi vmešaš rumenjaka, posebej stepeš beljake do trdih vrhov in ju narahlo združiš. Beri po vrsticah: sestavine levo, postopek se pomika v desno.
predgretje: Pečico ogrej na 190 °C. Dva ramekina po 180 ml namaži z maslom in potresi s sladkorjem.
opombe: Ramekina pripravi preden zameša testo: namaži ju z maslom in potresi s sladkorjem, odvečni sladkor pa stresi ven. Po tej hrapavi plasti se suflé vzpenja; po gladki steni zdrsne nazaj. Maslo in sladkor za to gresta poleg tistih s seznama sestavin.
Čokolado, maslo in smetano stopi v vodni kopeli — posoda nad loncem z vrelo vodo, dno se vode ne dotika. Temna čokolada zagori že pri 52 °C, zato ne na direktnem ognju.
Rumenjaka vmešaj, ko je zmes stopljena, a ne vroča, sicer se strdita.
Beljake stepi najprej z vinskim kamnom do mehkih vrhov, nato postopoma dodajaj sladkor in stepaj do trdih vrhov. Vinski kamen je kislina, ki beljakovo peno stabilizira.
Beljake vmešavaj narahlo in v treh delih: prvo tretjino bolj odločno, da čokoladno zmes zrahljaš, ostalo pa samo prepogibaj z lopatko. Vsak izgubljen mehurček je nižji suflé.
Ramekina napolni do vrha in rob obriši. Peci 15 minut na 190 °C in med peko ne odpiraj pečice.
Suflé postrezi takoj — v nekaj minutah se posede. To ni napaka, ampak narava jedi.
Beljakov je 2–3, recept pusti izbiro: z dvema je suflé bolj čokoladen, s tremi bolj zračen in višji. Na nakupovalnem seznamu so tri jajca, ker rumenjaka prideta iz istih.
Vir: Dark Chocolate Souffle, Michael Chu (Cooking for Engineers).

en.povzetek: A soufflé of 70% dark chocolate in two ramekins; 15 min at 190 °C, served at once.
en.opis: For {kolicina} — two 180 ml ramekins. Stir the yolks into the melted chocolate, whisk the whites separately to stiff peaks and gently fold the two together. Read row by row: ingredients on the left, the method moves to the right.
en.predgretje: Preheat the oven to 190 °C. Butter two 180 ml ramekins and coat them with sugar.

sestavine.ime: pinch of cream of tartar (1/16 tsp)

opombe: Prepare the ramekins before you mix the batter: butter them and coat them with sugar, tipping out the excess. The soufflé climbs up this rough layer; on a smooth wall it slides back down. The butter and sugar for this come on top of those in the ingredient list.
Melt the chocolate, butter and cream over a water bath — a bowl over a pan of simmering water, not touching it. Dark chocolate scorches from as low as 52 °C, so not over direct heat.
Stir in the yolks once the mixture has melted but is no longer hot, otherwise they set.
Whisk the whites with the cream of tartar to soft peaks first, then gradually add the sugar and whisk to stiff peaks. Cream of tartar is an acid that stabilises the egg-white foam.
Fold in the whites gently and in three parts: the first third more firmly, to loosen the chocolate mixture, the rest just folded with a spatula. Every lost bubble means a lower soufflé.
Fill the ramekins to the top and wipe the rim. Bake for 15 minutes at 190 °C and don't open the oven while it bakes.
Serve the soufflé at once — within minutes it sinks. That is not a mistake, just the nature of the dish.
The recipe allows 2–3 egg whites: with two the soufflé is more chocolatey, with three airier and taller. The shopping list says three eggs, because the yolks come from the same eggs.
Source: Dark Chocolate Souffle, Michael Chu (Cooking for Engineers).
